title: Which Lord of the Rings character are you? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Lord of the Rings quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Frodo, Sam, Gandalf, Aragorn, Legolas, Gimli, Galadriel or Bilbo. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
h1: Which Lord of the Rings character are you?
lede: Loyal like Sam, wise like Gandalf or brave like Aragorn? Answer 12 questions about adventure, friendship and second breakfast to find your Middle-earth match.
about: J.R.R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings follows a small fellowship on a huge journey, and its characters have stayed with readers and filmgoers for generations: Frodo's quiet courage, Sam's loyalty, Gandalf's wisdom and fireworks, Aragorn's humble strength, Legolas's grace, Gimli's gruff warmth, Galadriel's ancient light and Bilbo's love of comfort and stories. This quiz matches you with one of these eight.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Tolkien Estate, Middle-earth Enterprises, New Line Cinema or Warner Bros.; the names belong to their owners.

faq.a: Frodo Baggins, Samwise Gamgee, Gandalf, Aragorn, Legolas, Gimli, Galadriel and Bilbo Baggins.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every character appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.
Eight results keep the quiz short and fair. Gollum, Merry, Pippin and others may join in a later update.

frodo.name: Frodo Baggins
frodo.body: You are gentle, brave and quietly determined. You take on hard things others won't, even when you're afraid, and you keep going step by step. You may underestimate yourself, but your friends never do.

sam.name: Samwise Gamgee
sam.body: You are loyal, warm and down to earth, and you'd follow your friends anywhere. You keep everyone fed, hopeful and going when things are hard. You may think you're nobody special, but you are the heart of every group you're in.

gandalf.name: Gandalf
gandalf.body: You are wise, funny and a little mysterious. You see the big picture, nudge people toward their best and arrive exactly when you mean to. You love fireworks, a good chat and believing in people others overlook.

aragorn.name: Aragorn
aragorn.body: You are strong, humble and a natural leader who doesn't need the spotlight. You protect people quietly, keep your word and grow into big responsibilities. Trust that you're ready for them.

legolas.name: Legolas
legolas.body: You are graceful, calm and observant. You notice things before anyone else, stay steady under pressure and make difficult things look easy. Your calm helps your friends keep their heads.

gimli.name: Gimli
gimli.body: You are proud, stubborn and fiercely loyal, with a big laugh and a bigger heart. You might start as a grump, but once you're someone's friend, it's for life. You bring humor and courage to any fight.

galadriel.name: Galadriel
galadriel.body: You are wise, perceptive and full of quiet strength. You see into people and situations, give advice that lands and inspire others to be brave. People sense there's more to you than you show.

bilbo.name: Bilbo Baggins
bilbo.body: You love comfort, good food and a cozy home, and you're also braver and more curious than you look. Once you've had an adventure, you love telling the story. Your mix of homeliness and spark makes you great company.
